pointer_passages: Young and Pierce answered questions about school choice, environmental protections, pro-Palestine protests and more at the forum.

Photo by Adelyn Rabbitt / The Indiana Daily Student By Adelyn Rabbitt Mar 6, 2026 2:40 pm · Updated Mar 6, 2026 2:40 pm Two Democratic candidates for Indiana’s House of Representatives District 61, Matt Pierce and Lilliana Young, discussed pro-Palestine protests, school choice, environmental protections and more during a candidate forum Thursday.
Pierce, the incumbent, is facing a Democratic primary challenger , Lilliana Young, in the statehouse District 61 election for the first time in over two decades.
